$comment: Committed factory config. outputStyle switches on the Parker voice layer at .claude/output-styles/parker.md — the same system-prompt layer every shipped brand brain gets — so sessions in this repo talk plain and warm too. Personal overrides live in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

hooks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, runpy; r = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True); p = Path(r.stdout.strip()) / 'scripts/usage-log.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__') if r.returncode == 0 and p.is_file() else None" hook --runtime claude
